name: Inchiki Reibaishi
source:
Takumi is a while-collar worker, living a boring life. But one day, he hears that his friend gets married to a beautiful woman using feng shui. "That's it! Spiritualism! I'll be able to have sex with any girls using it!" He immediately decides target girls and takes action....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
拓海是一名过着无聊生活的白领。一天，他听说朋友凭借风水娶到了一位美女。"就是这个！灵媒术！用它的话，我就能与任何女孩上床！"他立刻选定目标并开始行动…
